commits.body: All seven setup jobs passed (results recorded by the pipeline on the default line). Lucene #14732, Solr #3158, jOOQ #19875 and Guava #7784 now also have jars built from the pins themselves, with full sha256 and the digests of the changed classes. So the regression separates the sides in 19 of 20 cases; for Guava, the fix's test does not compile on the parent. Noted: the jOOQ jar is not byte-reproducible between builds of one pin.
